home.aboutTitle: About the Arab Community in Noal
home.aboutP1: For over forty years, the blue shirt and red lanyard have been home to thousands of young people in the Arab community. The Arab branches circle in the Working and Studying Youth Movement is where our strongest friendships grew, where our shared path was shaped, and where generations of leaders and influencers were raised.
home.aboutP2: The experience in the branches, on trips and at gatherings left a deep mark on us. There we learned what responsibility is, how to lead by personal example, and the power of a group. The bonds formed then are the beating heart of our community – bonds that continue to accompany us, and the shirt is still in our hearts.
home.aboutP3: Today, our alumni stand at the forefront of every field: in education, medicine, hi-tech, local authorities and the public sphere. Everywhere we've reached, we carry with us the values of mutual responsibility and partnership we absorbed together.
home.aboutP4: The Arab community alumni network was established to reconnect the family. We invite you to renew connections, create new bonds and continue building our shared home together.
home.aboutP5: Here you can: find friends from the past and partners for the present, stay updated on current news and activities, join initiatives and volunteer with alumni teams, and take part in events, conferences and unique training sessions.
home.aboutP6: You were part of it, and you always remain part of it. We're waiting for you.

programs.sectionSubtitle: Leadership and education programs for movement alumni
programs.socialLeadershipDesc: A year of volunteering, branch activities, learning and more
programs.socialLeadershipExpanded: The Social Leadership Year is an annual program combining community volunteering, mentoring in branches, learning workshops, and hands-on training. The program is designed for alumni who want to continue contributing to the community.
programs.socialLeadershipPageSubtitle: A year of volunteering, branch activities, learning, and leadership development
programs.socialLeadershipContent1: The Social Leadership Year is a unique program of the Arab Branches Circle within HaNoar HaOved VeHaLomed. Through this program, movement alumni volunteer for an entire year in various branches and nests.
programs.socialLeadershipContent2: Participants undergo comprehensive training that includes educational tools, group management, activity planning, and social leadership. Alongside fieldwork, weekly learning sessions are held with top lecturers and facilitators.
programs.socialLeadershipContent3: The program provides a meaningful experience of community contribution, personal and professional development, and equips alumni with social leadership tools that accompany them throughout their lives.
programs.leadershipInstituteDesc: A year of studies and leadership training
programs.leadershipInstituteExpanded: The Leadership Institute is an advanced training program that includes academic studies, leadership workshops, meetings with key figures in various fields, and personal mentoring for each participant.
programs.leadershipInstitutePageSubtitle: A year of studies, training, and personal and professional leadership development
programs.leadershipInstituteContent1: The Leadership Institute is the advanced training program of the Arab Branches Circle. The program is designed for alumni with a movement background who wish to deepen their knowledge and tools in the field of leadership.
programs.leadershipInstituteContent2: Throughout the year, participants study topics such as personal and group leadership, social project management, public speaking, strategic thinking, and more. The studies combine theory and practice, with an emphasis on field implementation.
programs.leadershipInstituteContent3: Institute graduates go on to hold key positions in the movement, community, and Israeli society. The program grants a recognized completion certificate and a lifelong professional network.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.subtitle: Over 40 years of education, partnership, and pride
ourStory.content1: We are an integral part of HaNoar HaOved VeHaLomed for over 40 years.
ourStory.content2: We operate from within and for the Arab society in Israel, rooted in equal and active citizenship.
ourStory.content3: We take pride in our Arabic identity, language, and culture as a source of values and enriched shared life.
ourStory.content4: Our educational path is guided by moderation (Wasta), human equality, and the sanctity of life.
